system_facts: The card never shows the provider's business name, even though the query fetches it.

'Confirmed €45,000 — book now for race week' is free text typed by the provider into 'Price description'; the studio placeholder is 'From €1,200 per night, including taxes' and nothing validates or qualifies the wording.
When the price field is empty the card shows 'Ask the provider for a quote'.
The eyebrow 'access' is the raw internal kind; the studio has no 'yacht' kind or category.
